test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sunny starts from Point A and drives 17 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 12 km, turns right and drives 8 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: All turns are 90 degree turns only

Sunny starts from Point A and drives 17 km towards the east.

He then takes a right turn, drives 12 km, turns right and drives 8 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/075ae954eb3ff6dbe803bd6692c4cf3be36429ee13e562997b3074712d0669e8.png] 

Thus, Sunny should drive (12 km - 7 km) = 5 km in north direction in order to reach Point A from Point B.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
